traits.name: Cocytan Filth
traits.text: (disease, virulent); Saving Throw DC 18 Fortitude. Stage 1 enfeebled 1 (1 day) Stage 2 enfeebled 2 (1 day) Stage 3 enfeebled 3 (1 day)

traits.name: Infernal Eye
traits.text: ⬽ (divine, divination); The zebub records everything they see, and though they don't remember all observations, they can pass them along to another creature. The zebub replays 10 minutes of witnessed events to a touched willing creature, which receives the memories in a flash of information. By remaining in contact, the zebub can spend additional 3-action activities to replay more information. After relaying their visions to another, the zebub can't ever recall those events again.

traits.name: Sneak Attack
traits.text: The zebub's Strikes deal an additional 1d6 (1d6) precision damage to flat-footed creatures.

actions.name: Melee
actions.text: ⬻ mandibles +12 (evil, finesse, magical); Damage 1d10+3 (1d10+3) piercing plus 1d6 (1d6) evil and Cocytan filth
